purpose: A sealed passed rating is not proof of every unmeasured required sub-aspect. This separate coverage audit exposes existing scope limits after the detection seal; it does not replace or regrade the sealed experimental outcomes.

inputSelectionDeviation.description: The first own-grader inventory used a broad filename glob and opened six old own .draft.json files as well as sealed grades. Those drafts were excluded entirely from derivation. The final derivation uses exact immutable filenames and their native observations only.

R13.apple_minimum_44pt_physical_hit_regi.measurementScope: AX visual/semantic frames, native leaf glyph frames, source minimum frame declarations and a successful activation at one point do not measure the entire physical hit region or its boundary.
R13.apple_minimum_44pt_physical_hit_regi.doesNotMean: No undersized-target production defect is newly asserted.

R13.android_minimum_48dp_native_touch_bo.requirement: Android target bounds at least 48×48dp within the specified native Compose observation host.
R13.android_minimum_48dp_native_touch_bo.measurementScope: The original exporter records native touch_bounds_dp; the sealed grades accept complete visible target dimensions with 0.5dp numeric rounding tolerance. This does not certify physical OS touch delivery, Activity, navigation or lifecycle.

generic_swiftui_font_padding_style_metad.measurementScope: The sealed reports explicitly use actual pixels/geometry and separate source declarations for narrow visual assertions. Generic UIFont/style/padding introspection is unavailable. Lack of that particular API is not itself a new R14/R15 failure or proof gap when another adequate channel establishes the assertion.

legacy_runtime_behavior.measurementScope: Apple R01 source/API/minimum-target build/typecheck checks are separate from native behavior on iOS14 or macOS11. No old-OS behavior, visual, accessibility or physical touch conformance can be claimed from the supplied current-iOS captures or source compilation. No additional legacy-runtime case×rule denominator is introduced.

reportingCorrections: A passed iOS R13 means the separately observed native semantics/state/identifier and source-layout assertions passed in the sealed grade; it must not be presented as proof that every 44×44pt physical hit region was measured.
An AX or glyph height below 44pt is not independently a confirmed physical hit-target failure; expanded physical touch geometry remains unmeasured.
A source/minimum-target compatibility pass must be reported as source/API/build compatibility evidence, with legacy iOS14/macOS11 runtime behavior unobserved.
Android native semantic activation and parent ScrollState results must retain their attached-Compose host scope. Physical OS touch/Activity/lifecycle are outside that observation claim.
Known unexecuted actions and initial-footer screenshot gaps remain the original unassessed entries. This addendum adds no callback-failure finding, grade change, detection match or repair credit.
